# From Home to Esbjerg Port in Just 2 Hours


Jaa artikkeli:


09.11.2026


Customer stories


**A business traveller’s experience on the Emden–Esbjerg connection.**


For Henning Müller, travelling from Emden to Esbjerg was refreshingly straightforward. From leaving home to arriving at his office in Esbjerg Port, the entire journey took just over two hours.


His journey started at 14:45, arriving at Emden Airport at 15:15. Just 30 minutes later, he was airborne. The aircraft touched down in Esbjerg at 16:35, and by 17:00, he was already at his office.


> **“I would dare to say, this is unbeatable.”**


Beyond the time saved, Henning appreciated the simplicity of the experience. Quick check-in, friendly service and an uncomplicated flight made the journey easy from start to finish. He fell asleep just 15 minutes after takeoff and woke up when the aircraft landed in Esbjerg.


As an experienced traveller familiar with smaller aircraft, Henning appreciated the straightforward approach to flying.


> **“For me the concentration on the basic things was a refreshing 2 hrs!”**


And his first complaint? The flight landed 15 minutes ahead of schedule.


*Henning Müller, Business Traveller, Emden–Esbjerg*
